title: Baby Gangsta Sprite Sheet
description: A white rectangular card displays four sequential poses of a cartoon baby with a mohawk, wearing a white tank top and black shorts, set against bright pink backgrounds. The card is taped over a textured hot pink painting featuring large black stenciled text reading 'SEAS' and 'SAMM'.
prompt: A white horizontal card centered on a heavily textured bright pink canvas, displaying four side-by-side panels of a cartoon baby with a tall black mohawk, angry expression, white tank top and black shorts walking in sequence like a sprite sheet, each panel has a solid hot pink background, large black stenciled graffiti text partially visible behind the card spelling SEAS and SAMM, raw painted texture with visible brush strokes and tape, vibrant street art style
medium: mixed media, acrylic and stencil on canvas with printed card
